note: Curated research, outreach, publications, awards and professional milestones, newest first, dating back to the DCP25 Best Poster Award on 11 July 2025. Videos show verified YouTube thumbnails; ERN 2026 uses the official corrected poster and PDF; publications are resolved by bibliography ID. Award dates use the event or publication date, as documented.

items.title: Il nero che illumina il cervello | TEDxPavia
items.description: Martina Francesca Rizza and Alberto Arturo Vergani revisit Golgi, Ramón y Cajal and the scientific interpretations that shaped modern neuroscience.

items.title: Dopo il TEDx: intervista a Martina Rizza e Alberto Vergani
items.description: An interview by Chiara Barbati exploring Golgi's curiosity, the human side of scientific research, and why communicating science matters.
items.date_note: Shared by interviewer on 10 October 2026; the TEDx talk took place on 27 May 2026.

items.title: European Researchers’ Night: Modellizzando reti di neuroni
items.description: Public science outreach in Pavia, using computational models and simulations to illustrate how neurons and brain circuits work.

items.title: 2026 Best Review Article Award for the Hans Berger paper
items.description: The American Physiological Society awarded Alberto Arturo Vergani the 2026 Best Review Article Award of Advances in Physiology Education for his 2024 historical review on Hans Berger and the first human EEG recordings.
items.source: American Physiological Society · Advances in Physiology Education
items.date_note: Winner notified on 18 March 2026; the American Physiological Society publicly highlighted the award on 4 May 2026.

items.title: Golgi & Cajal on Stage: 120 anni dal Nobel
items.description: For Brain Awareness Week, Martina Francesca Rizza, Alberto Arturo Vergani and Simona Tritto organized a lecture-performance on the 1906 Nobel Prize, with theatre by Luca Munaretto and music by Renato Caruso.
items.source: Brain Awareness Week · University of Pavia

items.title: Joined the Global Burden of Disease Collaborator Network
items.description: Alberto Arturo Vergani joined the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) Collaborator Network, coordinated by the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) at the University of Washington. The network brings together researchers contributing to global health metrics and population health evidence.
items.image_alt: Official logo of the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME)

items.title: Best Poster Award at Dynamics and Complexity Pisa 2025 (DCP25)
items.description: Alberto Arturo Vergani received the DCP25 Best Poster Award in Pisa for research on cerebellar resilience and schizophrenia. The prize was sponsored by the journal Chaos, Solitons & Fractals (Elsevier). His poster contribution was also selected for an oral presentation.
items.date_note: Best Poster Award session held on 11 July 2025, the conference's final day; the prize was subsequently confirmed in correspondence with the organizers and Elsevier.
